    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">OpenCode系列---【OpenCode接入白山智算模板】</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="1白山智算api">1.白山智算api</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>如果你还在为token费用高而发愁，那么你可以先体验一把白山智算家推出的活动，注册实名制后，就送150元的额度，2026年3月15号之前，首次调用就再送300元，这样下来就送450元了，且额度永久不失效，如果你还觉得不够，你可以通过邀请，邀请一个则送200元，包括MiniMax-M2.5，GLM5等。这个是我目前发现的最有诚意的大模型api三方平台了。注册链接为：<a href="https://ai.baishan.com/auth/login?referralCode=TAwCe8f1hp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ai.baishan.com/auth/login?referralCode=TAwCe8f1hp</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="2opencode接入白山智算模板">2.OpenCode接入白山智算模板</h1>
<p>把<code>C:\Users\&lt;用户名&gt;\.config\opencode\opencode.json</code>这个json，替换成下面的即可。</p>
<pre><code>{
    "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
    "provider": {
        "baishan": {
            "npm": "@ai-sdk/anthropic",
		"name": "白山智算",
            "options": {
                "baseURL": "https://api.edgefn.net/v1",
                "apiKey": "替换成你自己的api秘钥"
            },
            "models": {
                "MiniMax-M2.5": {
                    "name": "MiniMax M2.5",
                    "modalities": {
                        "input": ["text"],
                        "output": ["text"]
                    },
                    "options": {
                        "thinking": {
                            "type": "enabled",
                            "budgetTokens": 8192
                        }
                    },
                    "limit": {
                        "context": 196608,
                        "output": 24576
                    }
                },
                "GLM-5": {
                    "name": "GLM-5",
                    "modalities": {
                        "input": ["text"],
                        "output": ["text"]
                    },
                    "options": {
                        "thinking": {
                            "type": "enabled",
                            "budgetTokens": 8192
                        }
                    },
                    "limit": {
                        "context": 202752,
                        "output": 16384
                    }
                },
                "GLM-4.7": {
                    "name": "GLM-4.7",
                    "modalities": {
                        "input": ["text"],
                        "output": ["text"]
                    },
                    "options": {
                        "thinking": {
                            "type": "enabled",
                            "budgetTokens": 8192
                        }
                    },
                    "limit": {
                        "context": 202752,
                        "output": 16384
                    }
                },
                "Kimi-K2-Instruct": {
                    "name": "Kimi-K2-Instruct",
                    "modalities": {
                        "input": ["text", "image"],
                        "output": ["text"]
                    },
                    "options": {
                        "thinking": {
                            "type": "enabled",
                            "budgetTokens": 8192
                        }
                    },
                    "limit": {
                        "context": 262144,
                        "output": 32768
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>


</div>
